activities.policies.description: A policy says who declares attendance for a minor with an account: the minor alone, the minor with the guardian confirming, or only the guardian. The group policy wins over the away-trip one, then the activity type, then the club. What is declared for each activity type (absence only or a confirmation) is set in the club settings.
